tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm grey in light, near-black green in dark. Ink, muted and violet all read on it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces that sit on bg: content panels, inputs, flow steps, stat tiles. Ink and muted both read on it.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Quiet fill for project cards and tiles on bg. Set text on it in ink or ink-soft; muted falls just under 4.5:1 on card in the light theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, panel and card. Also the fill of heavy rules.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on card, where muted is too faint. 7:1 or better on bg, panel and card.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, eyebrows and helper text on bg and panel only (4.7:1 and 5.3:1 in light). Never on card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between sections. Decorative only: do not use as the only border of a control.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a progress bar or a toggle, and the fill of dashed placeholder boxes.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The call-to-action colour: primary buttons, the highlighted row, big numbers on forest. Text on it is on-lime.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and arrow discs on lime (14:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Deep green surface for hero panels, the cover banner and the featured stat. Text on it is on-forest, numbers are lime.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text on forest (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: forest-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and eyebrows on forest (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Green fill for small round controls and arrow discs, lifted in dark so it stays visible on bg. Lime glyphs sit on it.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: The purple accent. Links, the spinning star, the active nav underline, the focus ring, connector arrows, violet buttons. Reads as text on bg, panel, card and lilac in both themes (5.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text on a violet fill (7:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Soft purple fill: card hover, the highlighted tag, a feature panel. A fill only. In light it is under 3:1 on bg, so never use it for text or as a border. Text on it is on-lavender.

tokens.name: on-lavender
tokens.usage: Text on lavender (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Pale purple wash behind a pull quote or a quiet tag. Text on it is on-lilac.

tokens.name: on-lilac
tokens.usage: Text on lilac (8.7:1 light, 9.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Positive status text, always with the word Active, Done or Received.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind ok text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waiting or in-progress status text, always with a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind warn text.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Overdue or error text on panel and bad-soft.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind bad text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the home hero and case-study titles. Sentence case, max 22 characters a line.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles on Work, About, Resume and Contact.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big result numbers. Set with tabular figures. Lime on forest, ink elsewhere.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles inside a case study.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I coordinate integrated marketing at Kootenay Co-op.
styles.usage: Running copy. Keep lines to about 62 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Pre-event promotional content across posts, stories and reels.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, list rows, form fields.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label above a title. Set in capitals, colour muted on bg and panel, forest-muted on forest.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a card's title and its tags.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between grid rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding inside a pull quote or forest panel.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between a title block and the content under it.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical space between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Text inputs and small image slots.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Flow steps, nested panels, placeholder boxes.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Project cards, stat tiles, forest and lilac panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, tabs, arrow discs.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Project card on hover. Pair with a 2px upward move.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Dialogs and pop-overs only.
